A display:none paragraph in production HTML is a worse audit substrate than the structured jsonl row; removing it loses nothing the archive doesn't already preserve.

Response: grep across the entire data/ tree returns exactly one match (data/sections.json:90); no other section uses this marker; no build script references the marker; no test pins it. Treating it as a one-off scaffolding leftover from the EXP-159 integration is the consistent reading.
